prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Cinderreach: black ash flats, volcanic vents and a dim grey sky full of drifting ash. A desolate but resolute theme with dark strings and spare flute. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
